```text
ComfyUI/
  models/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
```

## Required Custom Nodes

- [Director](https://github.com/seesee75-commits/ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3-Director)
- [KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)
- [VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite)

The remaining nodes come with ComfyUI. All selected models are already installed locally. Models and nodes retain their original authorship and terms.

properties.global_prompt: A gentle animated-film style short in a rainy city street at dusk. A small paper boat floats along the curb gutter, carried by rainwater past puddles, leaves and neon reflections. Consistent paper boat, street and lighting throughout. Sound of rain, water trickling and distant traffic. No dialogue, no music.
